messages:
Maya C: CI red on nightly-hetero-warmup (build #4321). Warmup failing on ~3/12 h100 nodes, test shard times out. Anyone around for a quick triage?
eng-ci-bot: build 4321 - nightly-hetero-warmup - FAILED
eng-ci-bot: failing tests: warmup_smoke::gpu_warmup_shard_7, warmup_smoke::gpu_warmup_shard_9
Liam R: ping - can you paste the job link + last logs?
Maya C: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/4321 (log tail below). Looks like a driver mismatch on two worker hosts.
Maya C: ```
[2026-03-17T04:12:03Z] RuntimeError: CUDA driver version mismatch
node: gpu-worker-17, nvidia-smi: Driver Version: 525.89.02
node: gpu-worker-23, nvidia-smi: Driver Version: 530.41.03
dmesg: NVRM: Xid (86): PID 12345: soft hang
```
Serena K: ugh, hetero pool. Are both nodes in the same canary image?
Noah P: I saw similar yesterday — the new canary image rolled to some hosts but not all. We need a targeted rerun on homogeneous nodes to confirm.
Liam R: can we quick-check host driver vs container runtime? Maya, can you run `docker exec` on the failing shard to get `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`?
Maya C: ran it, pasted gist: https://gist.github.com/maya/def123 - gist shows container driver reports 525.89.02 on one host and 525.89.02 (but kernel module 530 on host) on the other.
Liam R: that indicates host kernel modules and user driver mismatch -> Xid 86 soft hang. Fix options: 1) temporary rerun on nodes pinned to host-driver 525.89.02 2) coord with infra to roll back the 530 host-driver 3) bisect the canary image rollout to see when it started.
Maya C: I'm going to trigger a targeted rerun on the subset that is homogeneous. Can someone approve requeue? @Noah P @Serena K
Noah P: approve, pls use rerun tag `hetero-warmup-homogeneous` and `--pin-host-filter host_driver:525.89.02`.
Serena K: also add `--collect-dmesg` so we capture kernel logs if it flakes again.
Maya C: rerun queued: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/4321?rerun=homogeneous. Command used: `ci rerun 4321 --filter 'host_driver:525.89.02' --tag heterogeneous-fix --collect-dmesg`
eng-ci-bot: rerun job 4321-r2 queued on hosts [gpu-worker-05, gpu-worker-12, gpu-worker-19]
Liam R: if rerun passes, we can mark as infra rollout issue. If it fails, we'll request a bisect of image rollout windows (timeline: last good 2026-03-16T22:00 -> first bad 2026-03-17T02:30).
Maya C: rerun finished: PASSED on homogeneous hosts, warmup_smoke green.
Serena K: good. I'll open an infra ticket to rollback/coordinate driver rollout to avoid mixed pool. Ticket: INFRA-7892.
Noah P: also adding a short CI check to fail fast on heterogeneous host drivers for warmup jobs. I'll sketch the patch.
Maya C: thanks all, closing this triage. :thumbsup:
